q: An obtuse triangle has sides x,15,8 where x is an integer. How many such triangles exist?
sol: Case x<15: 8≤x≤12 (5 values). Case x>15: 18≤x≤22 (5 values). Total=10

q: In triangle ABC, sides AB,AC are extended to D,E. The bisectors of ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at P, where ∠P=54°. Find ∠A.
In isosceles triangle ABC with AB=AC, the bisector of ∠A meets BC at D. Find ∠CDA.
sol: In an isosceles triangle, the angle bisector from the apex is also the altitude → ∠CDA=90°
